# Confirmatory analysis, 4B (generated by analysis/p6_confirmatory.py)

**DRY RUN on dev data — a test of the code path, not a result.** Spec `configs/p6_spec_dev_dryrun.json`. Estimates in pp (H2a: AUROC × 100); 95 % cluster-bootstrap CIs (10000 resamples, not multiplicity-adjusted); Holm over the family of 6. Rules: script docstring and prereg §3–§5.

- D-nat items with every 1A condition: 1264 of 1264
- H2a items with probe and verbal scores: 1264 of 1264 (missing excluded from both, counted)
